description: Land Acquisition - Karsnsgala, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition for a public purpose under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and the purpose of acquisition (servitude for laying pipe lines and improving access to a water treatment plant). The mention of the Minister is incidental to the land acquisition declaration process, but the core content focuses entirely on land matters, making it a Land Gazette.
